name: Iris
description: This Test Connection validates the access against the IRIS Namespace and basic metadata extraction of schemas and tables.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that we can properly reach the IRIS Namespace and authenticate with the given credentials.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to IRIS. Check host, superserver port, Namespace, username and password.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List all the schemas available to the user.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch schemas. Grant SELECT on at least one schema to the user.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: From a given schema, list the tables belonging to it.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to fetch tables. Grant SELECT on the tables to ingest.

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: From a given schema, list the views belonging to it.

steps.name: GetClassDictionary
steps.description: Optional: read the class dictionary for calculated columns, index details and VECTOR element type and dimension.
steps.errorMessage: Optional: GRANT SELECT ON %Dictionary.PropertyDefinition TO <user> for full reflection and VECTOR detail. Ingestion works without it.
